# windowsddi_dhcp_reservation (Data Source)

Looks up one IPv4 reservation in a scope by IP address or client ID (`Get-DhcpServerv4Reservation`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By IP address.
data "windowsddi_dhcp_reservation" "printer" {
  scope_id   = "10.1.20.0"
  ip_address = "10.1.20.5"
}

# By client ID (MAC address), in any common notation.
data "windowsddi_dhcp_reservation" "by_mac" {
  scope_id  = "10.1.20.0"
  client_id = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope_id` (String) Scope to search.

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) Client ID (MAC address) to look up, in any common notation. Exactly one of `ip_address` and `client_id` must be set.
- `ip_address` (String) Reserved IPv4 address to look up. Exactly one of `ip_address` and `client_id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Reservation description.
- `name` (String) Reservation name.
- `type` (String) `Dhcp`, `Bootp` or `Both`.
